descriptor: Live countdown cards for dates that matter

voice.summary: Tickdown sounds like a stopwatch with a friendly face: crisp, numerical and glad when the big day arrives. Units and times lead, and feelings follow.
dos: Put days, hours, minutes and seconds in that order
Name the event and its date plainly

taglines: Know exactly how long to go
boilerplate: Tickdown is a countdown widget that tracks launches, offsites, quarter ends and personal dates with live flip-style digits, sorted so the soonest event is always first.

microcopy.error: Choose a future date and time.
microcopy.empty: No countdowns yet. Add your first.

logo.note: A pulse line suggests a ticking clock and a live heartbeat.
